as_told.title: NASA occult rituals and Launch Pad 33 (Dark Mission)

plain: Some say the US space agency NASA is full of hidden symbols from Freemasonry, a fraternal order with its own secret signs, and from the zodiac. The researcher Luis Elizondo makes the point without naming a source: "look at Launchpad 33 I mean everything is Masonic," he says, and adds that the Apollo moon missions follow "the zodiac signs." Jesse Michels returns to the idea in his own words, crediting a writer named Richard Hoagland and his book Dark Mission. He goes further and speaks of the idea that there are "cult rituals" behind the space program, again pointing to Launchpad 33. The claim matters to the tellers because it would mean the space program was shaped by a hidden belief system the public was never told about.
